query:
SELECT
                c.id,
                c.user_id,
                c.name,
                c.color,
                c.position,
                c.created_at,
                c.updated_at,
                COUNT(t.id) AS "tag_count!: i64"
            FROM
                tag_categories c
            LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.category_id = c.id
            WHERE
                c.user_id = $1
            GROUP BY
                c.id
            ORDER BY
                c.position ASC,
                c.name ASC
